__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Salt and Pepper are a per server, pick-up history list item.

You can find the guide __here__ if you don't know what any of that means.

No perk cards or magazines affect the yield of Salt and Pepper. It is unfortunately a one-for-one farm.

Thru-Hiker Perk Card under Agility and the Grocery Backpack from the Settlers can reduce the weight of Salt and Pepper.

Avoid using explosive weapons as the condiments can move. If the condiments do move and you can't find them, fast travel out of the cell, the next map icon over is fine and then come back. The cell should have reset and the condiments will be back in their spawn locations.

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

There are two types of condiment spawns in Fallout 76. One is a fixed spawn, for example, Pepper will always spawn at that location. The other type of spawn is an "Any spawn". An "Any" spawn can be either Salt, Pepper, Sugar, or Spices.

All fixed spawn location guides can be found here:
